title: ACIS-iChatBio
description: Agent-based script built with OpenAI’s Instructor framework to fetch, validate, and structure biodiversity occurrence data from the Atlas of Living Australia (ALA).

title: ICU Clinical Decision Support Agent
description: Built an agentic multimodal RAG system for ICU clinical decision support using LangGraph and Weaviate. The system retrieves clinical guidelines, patient records, and radiology reports, cross-references patient data against clinical thresholds, scores answer confidence, and escalates low-confidence results.

title: HALO-RAG
description: Built a self-verifying retrieval-augmented generation pipeline that reduces hallucinations through hybrid retrieval, claim extraction, NLI-based claim verification, targeted repair, and multi-stage evaluation. The system attributes failures to retrieval, generation, or verification and applies the appropriate correction strategy.

title: Movie Recommendation Engine
description: Implemented a PinSage-inspired recommendation engine using Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs) for personalized movie suggestions.

title: USGS Water Data Agent
description: Built an iChatBio agent that translates natural-language questions into deterministic, schema-validated queries across USGS sensor networks and laboratory water quality databases. The async FastAPI service returns real observations and audit-grade artifacts with circuit breakers, analyte indexing, out-of-band result storage, and a tiered testing and evaluation pipeline.

title: Gator Ticket Master
description: A ticket reservation platform for Gator Events that allows users to book and manage event seats efficiently with backend service support.

title: Secure Environment for EHR using Ethereum with RSA and NTRU
description: Designed and implemented a secure, decentralized Electronic Health Record (EHR) system on the Ethereum blockchain. This system leverages RSA and NTRU cryptographic algorithms for dual-layer security and utilizes IPFS for distributed file storage. Patients can encrypt, store, and share medical records with authorized healthcare providers via smart contracts written in Solidity.

title: AskPY
description: An intelligent assistant that answers Python-related queries using a dual-source retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline, integrating internal documentation search with web-based resources.

title: WaitWhat?
description: Built a video learning assistant that uses facial-expression signals to flag possible confusion and record timestamps. Integrated Whisper transcription, BART summarization, and OpenAI-powered question answering in Gradio.
